To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the tpb length of the anode is the most influential parameter of the polarization resistance and that the reaction mechanism of the Ni pattern anodes is similar to the one of the Ni/YSZ composite anodes.

the polarization resistance Rp decreases with increasing tpb length; Rp is inversely related to the tpb density; the charge transfer resistance Rt is the dominating resistance of the polarization resistance Rp; the charge transfer reaction is the rate-determining step; and the reaction order of the charge transfer reaction with respect to the gas phase oxygen is 1/4.
the polarization resistance is inversely proportional with the triple phase boundary length and the charge transfer resistance is inversely dependent on the triple phase boundary density.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the reaction mechanism of Ni patterned anodes.
a detailed analysis of the electrode processes occurring on Ni pattern anodes.
the reaction mechanism of the anodic reaction in solid oxide fuel cells with Ni pattern anodes.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the charge transfer resistance Rt decreases with increasing length of the tpb, whereas the double layer capacitance and the polarization resistance Rp are independent of the tpb.
the charge transfer resistance Rt is inversely proportional, whereas the double layer capacitance is proportional to the tbp length.
the tpb length is a very important parameter in determining the electrochemical performance of the anode.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the tpb length is a key parameter for the performance of Ni pattern anode materials.
the polarization resistance Rp of the patterned anodes is mainly determined by the charge transfer resistance Rt and the double layer capacitance.
the polarization resistance is determined by the charge transfer process and the double layer capacitance.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the tpb length is the most significant parameter to control the polarization resistance.
the polarization resistance can be reduced by increasing the tpb length of the patterned anode.
the polarization resistance Rp is mainly influenced by the charge transfer process.
